plans.note: Separate caps for each party at 9.1 (IBM) and 9.2 (Customer); check cap amount/formula, mutuality, consequential-damages exclusion and carve-outs (indemnity, confidentiality, IP, willful misconduct). 5.4 may push additional damage disclaimers; 14.2 confirms survival.

8.1 is IBM's indemnity — test for third-party IP infringement plus injury/property and misconduct coverage, and whether it is capped by 9.1. 8.2 is our indemnity — confirm it stays narrow; sec-1 appears to be the indemnity procedure sub-list (notice/control/cooperation).

14.16 Freedom of Action typically preserves each party's right to compete rather than restricting us; scan 14.11 No Resale and 14.17 Limitation of Licenses for any disguised field-of-use or business restriction before concluding no non-compete exists.
Check 14.16 and the services/charges provisions for any sole-source or exclusive-provider language; absent that, no exclusivity binds us.
Pricing sections are the only plausible home for MFN language; flag only if we are obliged to extend best terms to IBM.
14.8 Personnel is the likely non-solicit/hiring provision; check mutuality, duration, scope (personnel involved in the services) and a general-advertising carve-out.
3.4 governs convenience termination — check notice period, whether the right is mutual or IBM-only, and any termination charges/unamortized-cost recovery cross-referenced in 3.5 or 4.1.
3.2 Renewal — test for auto-renewal, length of renewal term, non-renewal notice window and any price uplift; 3.1 sets the initial term against which the window runs.

14.3 Choice of Law is the operative clause (check for an accepted jurisdiction and whether venue/courts are specified); 14.4 jury waiver and 14.14 Actions Period are related dispute mechanics to note.
14.10 — confirm we may assign to affiliates and to a successor by merger/asset sale without consent, and that IBM has no termination right on our change of control.

12.1 License and 14.17 Limitation of Licenses define IP allocation; 11.6 Content and 14.18 Data Protection cover our content/data — confirm no assignment or broad licence of our data or deliverables to IBM.
12.1 is the grant — check affiliate/contractor use, revocability, and territorial limits in 14.19; 14.17 may narrow the grant and 12.2 addresses Base Components maintenance.
11.3 Suspected Violations is the likely inspection/monitoring right against our use; check notice, frequency, on-site access and cost allocation, read with the AUP at 13.2.
Look for late-payment interest or termination/penalty charges in 4.2 and 3.5; genuine liquidated damages against us are unlikely but confirm before marking absent.
5.1 is IBM's warranty — assess substance, duration and remedy; 5.2 Exclusivity of Warranties and 5.4 Other Disclaimers likely disclaim implied warranties; 11.2 contains our reciprocal reps.
No insurance heading in the outline; check 14.12 Risk of Loss and 5.3 Security for any incidental coverage requirement before treating the rule as missing.

4.1 Charges and any Order Form-referenced minimums are the likely source of committed volumes; 11.5 Capacity Planning may impose forecast/commitment obligations. Pair with 3.4 exit rights if a take-or-pay exists.

3.5 Effect of Termination is the place for data return and wind-down assistance; check whether it provides a retrieval window and migration help, or only cessation of services and payment obligations.
